pending.title: #TSLA IS THIS THE SELL-THE-NEWS MOMENT? #Tesla #daytrading
pending.description:
Please ❤️like and 🔁share with fellow Tesla traders/investors

#Tesla surged almost 6% on Thursday into highly anticipated Cybercab event, closing at $376.37.

But today the stock is trading much lower. Is this the beginning of a classic sell-the-news reversal?

*

The post-event weakness puts #TSLA right around a critical short-term pivot – $365.82.

Holding/reclaiming this level keeps the door open for another test of the major $385.07–$387.52 resistance zone.

If TSLA breaks below $365.82 today, however, $350 could come into play quickly.

*

$350 is the bigger make-or-break level.

A drop into the low $350s doesn’t necessarily end the rally. That area could produce another short-term bottom and rotation back toward the upper $380s.

One tactical setup would be to cover shorts near the low $350s and potentially play another rebound toward resistance.

*

But a CLOSE below $350 would be a much more important momentum reversal.

That would put roughly $330.48 in play within 3–5 trading days, followed by the $289.54–$291.81 region over the next 3–5 weeks.

*

On the upside, $385.07–$387.52 remains the key resistance zone.

Tesla broke below its long-term channel roughly six weeks ago, triggering a longer-term sell signal with a $228.44 objective over 3–5 months.

The Cybercab rally has now brought the stock back toward the underside of that former channel, making the upper $380s a critical decision point.

For longer-term traders, this remains a potential area to exit longs or establish shorts unless Tesla can prove otherwise.

*

But there is also a bullish short-term scenario.

A close above $387.52 could trigger another 3–5 day swing higher toward $413.54.

And $413.54 is where the bigger picture could finally change.

If Tesla reaches that level but fails to break through, the longer-term bearish path toward the $280s and potentially $228.44 into Q1 2027 remains in play.

But a confirmed close above $413.54 over the coming weeks would signal a major technical reversal and could open the door to roughly the $550s over the following 3–5 months.

*

So after the Cybercab event, the technical map is clear:
– Above $365.82 → another $385–$387 test remains possible
– Below $365.82 → watch for $350
– Hold $350 → another rotation toward the upper $380s is possible
– Close below $350 → ~$330 first, then ~$290 becomes the bigger downside target
– Close above $387.52 → $413.54 comes into play
– Break above $413.54 → the longer-term bearish thesis changes dramatically

*

For now, the post-Cybercab drop has the early look of a sell-the-news reaction.

The real confirmation comes from what $TSLA does at $350 on the downside and $385–$387 on the upside.

*
